segments.name: used car
segments.description: Operates used car superstores in China, selling used cars directly to retail customers.
segments.evidence: The Group operates as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Retail customers in China pay for used cars bought through its superstores.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially all revenue was derived from customers located in China.

changes.text: The company divested its loan facilitation and salvage car businesses along with its dealer-facing operations.
changes.evidence: See "Item 4.A. History and Development of the Company—Divestitures of Our Loan Facilitation, Salvage Car and 2B Businesses."
